snippet.title: Autumn To Winter, Peaceful and Soothing Music by Tim Janis
snippet.description:
Autumn To Winter, Peaceful and Soothing Music by Tim Janis. Lets take a walk through Autumn at our mountain cabin here in the Rocky Mountains. Feel the peace and warm sun on us as the night cools and the stars appear. We are so happy you are here with us for this peaceful time and I hope you like my music :) 

It is so beautiful watching the snow mix with the Autumn colors. Please enjoy this beauty and peace while listening to my song Autumn Pathways.
Thank you for watching and listening, we are so happy you are here with us :) Yippeee :) 
Love, Peace and blessings, Tim & Elizabeth, Reno, Bella and Roo Roo

Please stop by our LIVE chat and say hello to me, Zunaira, Paige and Amna, we would love to get to know you :) Thank you 

Please tune in to on of our vlogs at our cozy cabin Home in the Rocky Mountains. We have lots of posted videos which contain views of the natural wildlife around our Rocky Mountain Home at 9,000 feet. From the beautiful humming birds that visit us throughout the summer and the cool cold river that runs by our cabin. We hope you enjoy visiting us at our home and find peace here, Thank you 
Peace , Love and Blessings, Tim & Elizabeth, Reno, Bella and Roo Roo

snippet.description:
Tum Nay Mujay Dakha Dia 😡 #shorts #siyani 

Hailing from a lower-middle-class family, Kiran is a selfish and arrogant girl who aspires to achieve a lifestyle through mending her ways and taking shortcuts. Kiran’s mother Nusrat Ara is aware of her daughter’s nature and doesn’t stop her from doing anything. On the contrary, Ujala is a well-mannered and beautiful girl who lives with Kiran’s family and strives to become independent. 

Zarbab, a handsome young man who belongs to an influential and wealthy family. His first meeting with Kiran turns out to be magical as he falls in love at first sight. Kiran sees him as a way to advance forward in life and builds a web of lies and deceit around Zarbab. On the other hand, Ujala is forced to live a life deprived of love and unfulfilled dreams.

Will Ujala ever find the love and respect that she deserves? After building her life on lies and deception, how long will Kiran be able to conceal the truth?

--------------------------------------------------------------------
The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story revolves around daily happenings in "Gokuldham Co-operative Society" and covers topical issues which are socially relevant. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalal.

snippet.title: Самое глупое ограбление в истории! #историиизжизни #кофестория #espresso
snippet.description:
#историиизжизни #история #меньшова #самаменьшова #my_coffeestory #кофестория #espresso #факты

Ограбить два банка без маски и улыбаться камерам наблюдения — Макартур Уилер считал свой план безупречным. Перед ограблением он натёр лицо лимонным соком и был уверен, что стал невидимым. Когда полиция показала видеозапись, оставался только один вопрос: как такое возможно, если всё было предусмотрено?

Эта история привлекла внимание психологов Дэвида Даннинга и Джастина Крюгера. Почему людям бывает трудно заметить собственную некомпетентность? Откуда берётся уверенность в ошибочных решениях? Разбираемся, что такое эффект Даннинга — Крюгера и почему убеждённость в своей правоте ещё не означает, что человек прав.
